cards.name: Cosima, God of the Voyage // The Omenkeel
cards.typeLine: Legendary Creature — God // Legendary Artifact — Vehicle
cards.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile Cosima. If you do, it gains "Whenever a land you control enters, if Cosima is exiled, you may put a voyage counter on it. If you don't, return Cosima to the battlefield with X +1/+1 counters on it and draw X cards, where X is the number of voyage counters on it."
Whenever a Vehicle you control deals combat damage to a player, that player exiles that many cards from the top of their library. You may play lands from among those cards for as long as they remain exiled.
Crew 1

cards.name: Theoretical Duplication
cards.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature an opponent controls enters this turn, create a token that's a copy of that creature.

cards.name: The Ozolith
cards.oracleText:
Whenever a creature you control leaves the battlefield, if it had counters on it, put those counters on The Ozolith.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, if The Ozolith has counters on it, you may move all counters from The Ozolith onto target creature.

cards.name: The One Ring
cards.oracleText:
Indestructible
When The One Ring enters, if you cast it, you gain protection from everything until your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life for each burden counter on The One Ring.
{T}: Put a burden counter on The One Ring, then draw a card for each burden counter on The One Ring.

cards.name: The Odd Acorn Gang
cards.oracleText:
Menace, trample, reach
Squirrels you control have "{T}: Target Squirrel gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
Whenever one or more Squirrels you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.

cards.name: The Ooze
cards.oracleText:
Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it leaves the battlefield, create a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter on it. (A Mutagen token is an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.")
{T}: Exile target card from a graveyard. Create a Mutagen token.

cards.name: Theopholos, Order Acolyte
cards.oracleText:
Mono Eminence — As the game begins, if Theopholos is your commander and your deck's color identity is mono-white, your starting life total is increased by 10.
Whenever Theopholos attacks, if your life total is greater than your starting life total, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.

cards.name: The Odd Acorn Gang // The Odd Acorn Gang
The Octopus Official
cards.oracleText:
Hexproof
When The Octopus Official enters, if you didn't have an active tournament, announce the top 8. (Reveal cards from your library until you reveal eight nonland cards. Randomly distribute them into four two-card piles, like a tournament bracket. Put land cards on the bottom in a random order.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, randomly put a card from each pile into your hand. The other cards advance to the next round. If only one card remains, you may cast it without paying its mana cost four times.
